'''Version 1.9.5''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on April 16th 2022.  It was 9.18 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes</u>==== 

*[[Dried Tendons]] recipe will now give Dried Tendons
*[[Living Scythe|Scythe]] causing lag when hitting mobs
*[[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated versions]] not melting to [[Evolution System|merge]] for creation of [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive versions]]
*"asiudghsaiu" message changed to "Phase decreased"
*[[Lures|Lure blocks]] lowering [[Evolution Phases|Evolution phases]] not updating current phase if a phase was drecreased
*Removed weird message caused by the [[Assimilated Cow|assimilated cow]]
*[[Assimilated Ender Dragon|Assimilated Enderdragon]] boss bar not showing up when attacked by player

====<u>Config</u>==== 

*"[[Reinforcement System]] Maximum Beckon Chunk" value changed from 3 to 2
*Tweaked loot table for each [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive]]/[[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted version]] (minus [[Primitive Devourer|Devourer]], [[Primitive Arachnida|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Arachnida]], [[Primitive Bolster|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Bolster]])
*New options:
*#"Version x XP Value"
*#"Cyst Item BlackList"
*#"Cyst Delay"

====<u>Changes</u>==== 

*Mobs that are considered child will never spawn with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]
*[[Parasitic Cyst|Parasite Cyst]] will now has "Active" in the name if its active
*Block cyst (Active):
*#If item can be damaged, it will consume 5 of the durability instead of consuming it in one go
*#It will eat items every 5 seconds instead of 2
*#Range reduced from 32 to 16
*#Parasites with griefing will place them more frequently to make for the loss of range 

*Minimum damage will now respect shields (they can disable shields if minimum damage != 0, only Primitive and higher tier versions)
*[[Reinforcement System]] will not send [[Stage I Beckon|Beckons]] if there is one too close to the call

====<u>Mobs</u>==== 

*[[Primitive Manducater|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Manducater]] can now bee seen while it has the "INVISIBILITY" effect
*[[Assimilated Cow]] charge attack will now respect iframes
*Added [[Crux]] sac(s) animation
*[[Assimilated Big Spider]] will no longer drop lure components
*Little tweak for the [[Assimilated Ender Dragon|Assimilated Enderdragon]] texture
*Reduced melee attack cooldown from 20 to 10 ticks for:
*#[[Rupter]]
*#Manducater
*#[[Assimilated Wolf]]
*#[[Heed]]
